result.summary: The screen is largely coherent, but there are a few visual/behavioral inconsistencies: the active 'Pizza' category filter does not appear to filter the listings, the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards, and one carousel card uses a mismatched light image background.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (black/active), yet the content below is unfiltered — 'Fastest near you' shows a poké bowl and a burger joint, and 'Popular right now' leads with a ramen bar. The selected filter state does not match the displayed results.
issues.suggestion: Either apply the filter so only pizza restaurants are listed when 'Pizza' is active, or default the selection to 'All' so the chip state matches the content.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card has a dark/translucent circle with a white heart. This looks like an unintended inconsistency rather than a state difference (neither appears favorited).
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment for the favorite icon across all cards, reserving a distinct style only for the active/favorited state.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light gray background while the adjacent burger and pasta thumbnails have dark backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven; the white time badge also has weaker contrast on the light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds (or add a consistent gradient overlay) across carousel thumbnails and ensure the time badge keeps sufficient contrast on light imagery.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' row omit rating information that the 'Popular right now' cards display, creating inconsistent card metadata across the page.
issues.suggestion: Include the same core metadata (rating, cuisine) on carousel cards, or intentionally document the compact variant so the difference reads as deliberate.
